title: Hussain Aur Abbas
body:
HAI DEENE HAQ KA SAHARA HUSAIN AUR ABBAS
WAFAO SABR KA KABA HUSAIN AUR ABBAS
WATAN SE QULDE BARI LE GAYA NASEEB MERA
KIYE HAI JAB BHI ISHARA HUSAIN AUR ABBAS
ATA KARENGE HUME QULD ME MAKAN KAYI
ALI O FATIMA SHABBAR HUSSAIN AUR ABBAS
NISAR HOGAYE DONO JAHAN QALAM PA MERE
QALAM NE JAB BHI YE LIKHA HUSAIN AUR ABBAS
YAZEED NASL TERI MIT GAYI JAHAN SE MAGAR
HAR EK DIL ME HAI ZINDA HUSAIN AUR ABBAS
KIYA HAI AUNO MOHD NE ISS TARHA HAMLA
KE JAISE KARTE HAI HAMLA HUSSAIN AUR ABBAS
QALAM UTHAIYE HASSNAIN AUR YE LIKHDIJIYE
HISARE SABR ME ZINDA HUSSAIN AUR ABBAS
